speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you tell me how long you've been experiencing these nosebleeds and petechiae, and have you noticed any bleeding from your gums or in your stool?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old male. The child's parent reports that the child has been experiencing frequent episodes of nosebleeds and has had several instances of bleeding from the gums. Additionally, there have been occurrences of unexplained bruising and petechiae, primarily on the distal extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does the child have a history of recurrent infections, and have you noticed any bleeding from the umbilical stump that persisted beyond the first week of life? I would also like to know if there is any family history of bleeding disorders.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Frequent epistaxis. I also have Mucous membrane bleeding, Diffuse petechiae on distal extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text: I need to clarify if the child has had any recurrent bacterial infections, such as otitis media or pneumonia, and whether there is any family history of bleeding disorders. Additionally, has there been any delay in wound healing or excessive bleeding after vaccinations?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical issues. Up-to-date on vaccinations. Social history: Attends preschool. Lives with parents and one older sibling.
